posts.text:
Indeed: if we actually had AGI we would not need forward deployed engineers.


Hamel Husain (@HamelHusain)

Two simultaneous AI narratives right now:

1) You can now do the work of 20 people, learn anything and create anything with AI.  Just learn how to use claude.  

2) We are investing Billions in forward deployed engineers to help you implement AI b/c its too time consuming and hard for you to do it yourself.  

I skew more towards #1, fwiw. But I find these narratives to be incongruent.
